introduction.definition: The mud settler (primary thickener) separates red mud from pregnant liquor after digestion. Flocculant added in the feedwell makes the mud settle quickly; clear liquor overflows to polishing filtration and thickened mud is pumped to the washers.

working_principle.characteristic_curve: Settling flux curve; overflow clarity vs flocculant dose.

pressure.title: Clear liquor above, compacted mud below
pressure.description: Digested slurry is diluted and dosed with flocculant in the feedwell; flocs settle quickly, leaving clear pregnant liquor that overflows to security (polishing) filtration. The mud compacts in the lower zone and the rakes move it to the underflow cone. Overflow clarity (often ≲ 100 mg/L solids) and underflow density are the key performance targets.

foundation: Large ring foundation or concrete tank; centre pier carries the rake drive and torque.
alignment: Level launders so overflow is even all round; centre the drive and shaft.
piping: Feed to feedwell with flocculant dosing points; underflow pumps with standby and flushing; overflow to downstream.
commissioning: Fill with water, run rakes and test torque alarms and lift; start feed and flocculant; build mud bed gradually.

lubrication: Agitator gearbox oil and motor bearings per maker; no lubrication for static parts.

video_tutorials.title: Mud Settling Tank — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Mud Settling Tank.
The mud settler (primary thickener) separates red mud from pregnant liquor after digestion.
Flocculant added in the feedwell makes the mud settle quickly; clear liquor overflows to polishing filtration and thickened mud is pumped to the washers.
Typical applications include primary residue (red mud) separation after digestion; high-rate thickening in mineral processing.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Settler: Rake Arms & Blades (move mud to the centre cone), Underflow (mud) Pump, Underflow (mud) Pump — Shaft & Coupling (turning).
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

script.narration: How the Mud Settling Tank works.
Diluted digested slurry enters the feedwell.
Flocculant forms flocs that settle.
Clear liquor overflows.
Rakes move mud to the cone; pump takes underflow.
The drive turns the rakes slowly.
The flow overlay traces the liquid from suction to discharge.
Digested slurry is diluted and dosed with flocculant in the feedwell; flocs settle quickly, leaving clear pregnant liquor that overflows to security (polishing) filtration.

video_tutorials.title: Mud Settling Tank — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Mud Settling Tank.
Overflow clarity and torque.
Flocculant system check.
Inspect rakes.
Watch for poor clarity: solids in overflow. Common cause: low flocculant, overload.
Watch for high torque: trip. Common cause: mud build-up.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
